# Dyspatch
## About Dyspatch
Dyspatch empowers your team to create, innovate, and grow conversations with your customers globally. Our mission is to revolutionize how global teams create personalized communications - from emails to SMS, push, and voice notifications - all without writing code.
Dyspatch is more than an email builder, it’s the centralized platform where all your communication comes together to unleash creativity and strategy. By streamlining the creation process of email, SMS, push, and voice notifications, your team can deepen personalization, improve brand consistency, and scale your business globally. Dyspatch empowers teams of all sizes to craft stunning, high performing emails without writing code.
- Support for both technical and non-technical users
- Flexibility without template lock-in
- Control, collaboration, and streamlined deployment
With Dyspatch, you can create personalized, data-driven experiences for your customers and unleash growth and retention. As enterprises scale globally, managing multiple channels efficiently becomes critical - this is where Dyspatch excels. Our intelligent solution integrates email, SMS, push, and voice notifications while maintaining perfect brand consistency and compliance. We understand enterprise challenges: complex workflows, strict guidelines, and the need for speed without compromising quality. That's why we've built robust features for dynamic content, personalization, and cross-channel analytics that streamline production and drive results. With Dyspatch, teams can orchestrate sophisticated customer journeys, optimize resources through centralized asset management, and accelerate time-to-market for global campaigns. Partner with us to elevate your enterprise strategy and unlock growth through more efficient, engaging customer connections.
## Key Features
- **No Code Email Builder**: Dyspatch offers an intuitive, drag-and-drop builder that makes it easy to create both transactional and marketing emails. It also supports SMS, push, and voice notifications, giving teams flexibility across channels without needing to code
## Who Uses Dyspatch?
Dyspatch is the customer communications platform that global brands love. From email to push and SMS, Dyspatch makes personalization and collaboration a cinch. No coding knowledge required! Global brands like Canva, Vetcove, Healthylife, Coda, Culture Amp, and more use Dyspatch to create and collaborate on their communications
## Use Cases
- **Email Builder**: Build and collaborate on your Transactional then easily export them to your CRM or ESP with Dyspatch. 
- **SMS and Push notifications**: Build and collaborate on customized SMS and Push notification campaigns in Dyspatch.
- **Customer Profiles**: Built and test your complex personalized email content with Dyspatch’s Customer profiles and visual code builder. Test all use cases quickly and easily without having to export to your ESP for testing. 
- **Localizations and Email Translation**: Translate your emails with one click using our built in integration support for XTM International, Crowdin, Phrase, Phrase Strings, Smartling, and built-in AI translations. 
- **Integration support**: Build your marketing and transactional emails in dispatch, then export them to your sending platform of choice. Dyspatch supports popular ESPs and CRMS, such as: Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable, Braze, Sendgrid, Sendpulse, Sparkpost, and more!
- **Email Guardrails**: Never send a broken email again with Despatch’s built in Email Quality Assurance, and pre-send checklist. 
- **Email Design**: Design your emails in Figma, Photoshop and more, then import your email design system into dyspatch for easy implementation. 
## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What else can I do with Dyspatch’s email builder software?**: Dyspatch is more than just email builder software. First off, you get a custom modular design system. Fully customizable, on-brand modules make it easy to create templates quickly and efficiently. You also get access to our library of pre-coded interactive Apps in Email. Powered by AMP for Email, these apps can 5x engagement. And Dyspatch serves as a centralized hub for email production. Think of it as a content management system for both your transactional and marketing email campaigns. Workspaces, themes and blocks, and an image library help you stay organized, while annotated comments and built-in approval workflows streamline collaboration. You in?
Think of it as a centralized hub for your email production. With built-in commenting, permission levels, and approval workflows, Dyspatch makes collaboration easy. By tracking feedback in one place and providing total transparency, Dyspatch streamlines the entire email creation process.
- **How does Dyspatch’s visual email editor work?**: Dyspatch is an industry-leading solution for email production and management. With Dyspatch, you can build engaging, interactive emails, without having to write code. By leveraging a custom modular email design system, non-technical teams can deploy beautiful, on-brand campaigns faster and achieve greater operational efficiency.
Think of it as a centralized hub for your email production. With built-in commenting, permission levels, and approval workflows, Dyspatch makes collaboration easy. By tracking feedback in one place and providing total transparency, Dyspatch streamlines the entire email creation process.
Dyspatch leverages a unique modular design system. Rather than just templates, which can be rigid and stifle your team’s creativity, these modules are fully customizable and reusable. This system gives you the flexibility to pull modules into any template, while staying on theme and on brand. If you need a new module, it’s easy to build one yourself, or let our #emailgeeks lend a hand!
- **How can I know if Dyspatch’s email builder software is right for me?**: Dyspatch has a lot to offer, but whether it’s right for you will depend on your needs. When choosing an email builder solution, one approach is to consider the problem you’re trying to solve. Do you struggle with broken emails? Is your time to market on email campaigns painfully slow? Are there inefficiencies in your email workflow that lead to mistakes and lost revenue? Do you need a solution to streamline and scale your email localizations? Are you looking for a platform that gives you more flexibility and freedom to innovate? If any of these problems resonate with you, then yes, Dyspatch is a great choice.
- **How much does the Dyspatch email builder cost?**: It varies! We offer monthly or annual pricing plans for teams of all sizes. If you go with an annual plan, you get an additional 10% off. All plans include integrated Litmus testing, annotated comments and approval workflows, and access to our interactive email builder, featuring a library of pre-coded AMP email apps.
## API and Integrations
Dyspatch exposes public APIs for automating workflows and integrating with other tools. Visit [API Documentation](https://www.Dyspatchapps.com/docs/api) for more information.

Have more questions about Dyspatch's AI marketing tools?
 
 
 
We have answers! Read on for a quick overview of Dyspatch’s email builder software, and what it can do for you.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What else can I do with Dyspatch’s email builder software? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dyspatch is more than just email builder software. First off, you get a custom 
modular design system
. Fully customizable, on-brand modules make it easy to create templates quickly and efficiently. You also get access to our library of pre-coded interactive 
Apps in Email
. Powered by AMP for Email, these apps can 5x engagement. And Dyspatch serves as a centralized hub for email production. Think of it as a content management system for both your transactional and marketing email campaigns. Workspaces, themes and blocks, and an image library help you stay organized, while annotated comments and built-in approval workflows streamline collaboration. You in?
 
Think of it as a centralized hub for your email production. With built-in commenting, permission levels, and approval workflows, Dyspatch makes collaboration easy. By tracking feedback in one place and providing total transparency, Dyspatch streamlines the entire email creation process.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How does Dyspatch’s visual email editor work? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dyspatch is an industry-leading solution for email production and management. With Dyspatch, you can build engaging, interactive emails, without having to write code. By leveraging a custom modular email design system, non-technical teams can deploy beautiful, on-brand campaigns faster and achieve greater operational efficiency.
 
Think of it as a centralized hub for your email production. With built-in commenting, permission levels, and approval workflows, Dyspatch makes collaboration easy. By tracking feedback in one place and providing total transparency, Dyspatch streamlines the entire email creation process.
 
Dyspatch leverages a unique modular design system. Rather than just templates, which can be rigid and stifle your team’s creativity, these modules are fully customizable and reusable. This system gives you the flexibility to pull modules into any template, while staying on theme and on brand. If you need a new module, it’s easy to build one yourself, or let our #emailgeeks lend a hand!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How can I know if Dyspatch’s email builder software is right for me? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dyspatch has a lot to offer, but whether it’s right for you will depend on your needs. When choosing an email builder solution, one approach is to consider the problem you’re trying to solve. Do you struggle with broken emails? Is your time to market on email campaigns painfully slow? Are there inefficiencies in your email workflow that lead to mistakes and lost revenue? Do you need a solution to streamline and scale your email localizations? Are you looking for a platform that gives you more flexibility and freedom to innovate? If any of these problems resonate with you, then yes, Dyspatch is a great choice. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How much does the Dyspatch email builder cost? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
It varies! We offer 
monthly or annual pricing plans
 for teams of all sizes. If you go with an annual plan, you get an additional 10% off. All plans include integrated Litmus testing, annotated comments and approval workflows, and access to our interactive email builder, featuring a library of pre-coded AMP email apps.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is Dyspatch? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dyspatch is enterprise email template management software — the email production platform global brands use to design, approve, and ship transactional and marketing emails at scale. Teams comparing alternatives to Stensul, Stripo, and Chamaileon choose Dyspatch for its no-code email builder, brand and approval controls, and ESP-agnostic deployment across every system that sends.

Centralize your email production from step one to step done
 
 
 
With the Dyspatch email builder, users of all skill levels can create interactive emails using pre-coded modules and collaborate on production. No more workarounds, custom code, or broken code. And no more time wasted!
 
Get a demo

Migration was straightforward, the team was hands-on throughout, and we're now shipping beautiful emails in a fraction of the time.

Dyspatch services
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Variants
 
With Variants, your team will be able to turn your email design system into a powerhouse with a greater variety of on-brand customization options. Now available in the theme editor, Variants empower you to create multiple pre-styled versions of any element (buttons, text, headers, and more) that your team can instantly apply to their designs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer profiles
 
Personalization is pivotal for every marketing team; it’s the best way to build trust with your customers and drive ROI from each email you send. Dyspatch makes in-depth personalization a cinch, with 
Customer Profiles
. Build profiles for your customer personas, and watch Dyspatch do the rest.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
No-Code Visual SMS Builder
 
Create complex, highly personalized Emails & 
SMS marketing
 messages in minutes. Leverage conditional logic to empower hyper-personalized customer profiles. Our built-in design system guardrails ensures brand compliance every time.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Engaging interactive email experiences
 
Boost results with our library of pre-coded, 
interactive, and dynamic content blocks
. Embed review forms, surveys, live product data, and more directly into your emails and see your engagement and conversion rates skyrocket by up to 500%.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Efficient, centralized team collaboration
 
Streamline your entire email creation process. 
Easily collaborate
 with key stakeholders all in one, centralized place. Take advantage of built-in commenting and approval workflows to eliminate mistakes, achieve full transparency, and speed up time to market.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Scalable email template localization
 
Make email localization worthwhile at both small and large scale. With Dyspatch, template localization is easy and exports are automated. The result? A simplified 
email localization
 workflow that minimizes duplication, cuts costs, and speeds up production timelines.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Flexible integrations with any ESP
 
Integrate with one or many ESPs. Manage both marketing and transactional emails in Dyspatch and easily sync with any ESP for sending. Bonus: All our integrations support conditional data and localized content.
 
Integrate with ease
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Expert services on demand
 
Super serving our customers is one of our core values. We’re all email experts, and we genuinely love what we do. We can assist you with design, block building, email layouts, troubleshooting, and more. We’re always here to help.

Have more questions about Dyspatch's interactive email builder?
 
 
 
 
We have answers! Read on for a quick overview of Dyspatch’s email builder software, and what it can do for you.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What else can I do with Dyspatch’s email builder software? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dyspatch is more than just email builder software. First off, you get a custom 
modular design system
. Fully customizable, on-brand modules make it easy to create templates quickly and efficiently. You also get access to our library of pre-coded interactive 
Apps in Email
. Powered by AMP for Email, these apps can 5x engagement. And Dyspatch serves as a centralized hub for email production. Think of it as a content management system for both your transactional and marketing email campaigns. Workspaces, themes and blocks, and an image library help you stay organized, while annotated comments and built-in approval workflows streamline collaboration. You in?
 
Think of it as a centralized hub for your email production. With built-in commenting, permission levels, and approval workflows, Dyspatch makes collaboration easy. By tracking feedback in one place and providing total transparency, Dyspatch streamlines the entire email creation process.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How does Dyspatch’s visual email editor work? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dyspatch is an industry-leading solution for email production and management. With Dyspatch, you can build engaging, interactive emails, without having to write code. By leveraging a custom modular email design system, non-technical teams can deploy beautiful, on-brand campaigns faster and achieve greater operational efficiency.
 
Think of it as a centralized hub for your email production. With built-in commenting, permission levels, and approval workflows, Dyspatch makes collaboration easy. By tracking feedback in one place and providing total transparency, Dyspatch streamlines the entire email creation process.
 
Dyspatch leverages a unique modular design system. Rather than just templates, which can be rigid and stifle your team’s creativity, these modules are fully customizable and reusable. This system gives you the flexibility to pull modules into any template, while staying on theme and on brand. If you need a new module, it’s easy to build one yourself, or let our #emailgeeks lend a hand!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How can I know if Dyspatch’s email builder software is right for me? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dyspatch has a lot to offer, but whether it’s right for you will depend on your needs. When choosing an email builder solution, one approach is to consider the problem you’re trying to solve. Do you struggle with broken emails? Is your time to market on email campaigns painfully slow? Are there inefficiencies in your email workflow that lead to mistakes and lost revenue? Do you need a solution to streamline and scale your email localizations? Are you looking for a platform that gives you more flexibility and freedom to innovate? If any of these problems resonate with you, then yes, Dyspatch is a great choice. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How much does the Dyspatch email builder cost? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
It varies! We offer 
monthly or annual pricing plans
 for teams of all sizes. If you go with an annual plan, you get an additional 10% off. All plans include integrated Litmus testing, annotated comments and approval workflows, and access to our interactive email builder, featuring a library of pre-coded AMP email apps.
